intent: Persist a resumable interruption when a saved benchmark manifest cannot proceed because its bounded preparation or foreground service promotion never completes, before execution ownership becomes idle.
preservation: Keep the same ten-second preparation and foreground promotion bounds and one existing execution owner.
Preserve explicit stop origin, prior committed receipts and unknown outcomes.
No runner invocation or replay occurs before service readiness.
Persist the still-owned prepared batch disposition before publishing idle.
No generated source inventory, gate, dependency or remote-ref changes.
diagnosis: A saved manifest remained QUEUED after either startup child timeout canceled its owner; completion only persisted preferences. The durable batch had no remaining execution owner and was not resumable until process recovery.
implementation: Handle the preparation and foreground-readiness child timeouts while the parent execution remains active; report their distinct fixed causes.
Use the existing canonical store mutex to interrupt only a still-QUEUED batch with no active ordinal, model item, or audit probe.
Preserve the latest accepted plan, settled and unknown results, original counters, and any explicit stop origin.
Complete the bounded interruption checkpoint before ownership cleanup; retain SERVICE_INTERRUPTION and the distinct canonical PREPARATION_TIMEOUT or FOREGROUND_READINESS_TIMEOUT event.
An own timeout always receives the appropriate fixed stage explanation unless this attempt was explicitly stopped; retained-results guidance is conditional on a real resumable saved batch.

validation.baseline_host: Reproduced on complete unmodified coordinator across six targeted cases: five expected failures cover saved audit/model readiness timeouts, preparation after manifest commit, preparation without a manifest, and failed resume acknowledgement; normal foreground acknowledgement passes. All timeout cases retain the real ten-second production bounds.
validation.canonical_fast: PASS: 387 tests in 45.194 seconds on final production source. Source inventory regenerated locally and excluded from commit. Android regex check: 1229 literal patterns, 73 dynamic patterns not evaluated, zero errors; physical QNN device execution remains unverified.
validation.ktlint: PASS: pinned ktlint 1.3.1 on coordinator, store, and integration tests; git diff --check clean.
validation.full_android: Four actual Room integration regressions added, including real readiness timeout plus failed resume admission, no-replay successful resume and reopen, queued-only atomic preservation, preparation after commit, and preparation without a manifest. No local Android SDK; execution requires full Android CI.
validation.actual_coordinator_host: PASS: 6/6 cases in 50.823 seconds with unchanged real ten-second gates; complete coordinator and exact checkpoint/store-interruption methods compiled without substitution. Test bodies are byte-identical to baseline. Android/preferences/Room DAO and runner-invocation boundaries are explicit; not Room/device/probe execution evidence.
validation.independent_review: UI review confirms ownership stays reserved through checkpoint, no pre-readiness runner invocation, preserved old stopped evidence and resumability, and fixed stage-specific explanations without fabricated saved results. No remaining concrete finding.
